mechanism.family: Betting-entry blog: free-credit 'winnings' (M31) withdrawable only after an 'AML clearance certificate' fee is transferred to a personal account (M32)
mechanism.summary: Captured: Thai SEO blog 'ทางเข้า sbobet สโบมือถือ' with seven posts steering readers to SBOBET/UFABET entry links. Added: a wallet page showing 300 baht free credit turned into 18,450 baht of winnings, a withdrawal that is held until a 1,850 baht anti-money-laundering clearance certificate fee is transferred to an individual's bank account (slip sent by LINE), plus an FAQ page.
mechanism.source_basis: Thai Anti-Money Laundering Office / Royal Thai Police and Bank of Thailand warnings on illegal betting sites that demand fees or 'clearance' transfers before paying out; FTC and Scamwatch advance-fee and fake-winnings advisories.
